messages.content:
The SQL query is correct and does not contain any of the common mistakes listed. It properly uses `JOIN`, `GROUP BY`, `ORDER BY`, and `LIMIT`. The query also correctly handles the aggregation and ordering of the results.

Now, I will execute the query using the provided tool.

args.query: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalAmount FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC, c.CustomerId LIMIT 5;
